summary: Vistra Corp. filed an 8-K reporting that its indirect, wholly owned subsidiary Vistra Operations Company LLC entered an Eleventh Amendment to its Commodity-Linked Credit Agreement, dated September 30, 2026, with lenders and Citibank, N.A. as administrative and collateral agent. The amendment extends the Revolving Credit Maturity Date from September 30, 2026 to September 29, 2027 and aligns certain terms with the Borrower's Corporate Credit Agreement. The filing also satisfies Item 2.03 disclosure of the direct financial obligation. No equity, M&A, or special-situation event is present; this is a routine credit-facility maturity extension. Watch only for liquidity and covenant modifications.
